key.name: show-percentage
key.summary: Show pinned devices in the panel
key.description: Show devices pinned in memory for this session, each with its kind icon and battery when available, and refresh the panel every 60 seconds.

key.name: battery-bar
key.description: Use a vertical bar instead of a numeric percentage for each pinned device. Missing readings do not produce a bar.

key.name: hide-logo
key.summary: Hide the extension icon when devices are pinned
key.description: While pinned devices are shown in the panel, hide the extension icon and keep their kind icons and batteries. Ignored when no pinned device is shown, so the panel button is never left empty.
